case.title: The Mysterious Dinner
case.introduction: It is a rainy night in the Grand Oak Hotel. A famous chef is found dead in the dining room. One guest is not who he says he is.
case.escape_plan: The killer plans to leave in the hotel lobby at midnight

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.description: Long table with candles. The chef lies on the floor.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: Busy. Chef used to cook here.

characters.name: Michael Hale
characters.alibi: In the lobby reading a book
lies: He says he is a hotel guest

characters.name: Lisa Grant
characters.secret: She is good at reading faces

characters.name: Dr. Alan Reed
characters.secret: He once treated a famous chef
characters.alibi: In the lounge reading a book

evidence.name: Poisoned Drink
evidence.description: Red wine with a faint smell

hidden_clues: The name Michael Hale is not on hotel records. The real name is Mark Jensen.
red_herrings: The red tie was found in Eve's bag. It does not link to the crime.

solution.reasoning: All key evidence points to Michael Hale, but his name is fake. The real name Mark Jensen is hidden. He used the drink to poison the chef.

state.current_objective: At Grand Oak Hotel tonight, 4 guests are trapped — and one is lying about who they are. Match the clues to the lies and point out the guilty one behind chef death, suspected poisoning. There are many clues to help you.

exchanges.answer: I look around the lobby. It’s quiet. I see a few guests at the tables. The hallway is dark, but the lights are on. I keep sipping my tea.

exchanges.question: which guests at the tables
exchanges.answer: I don’t see anyone else. Just a few people at the tables. I keep looking, but no one stands out. I’m just sipping my tea.

exchanges.answer: Oh no! I’m so sorry. I don’t know what happened to the chef. I was in the kitchen making dessert when it happened. I hope the staff is okay.

exchanges.answer: I’m not sure. It’s probably a few feet, maybe a short walk to the dining room.

exchanges.answer: I didn’t see anyone heading that way. I was busy with desserts. I laughed, but I’m not sure.

exchanges.question: any clue or unusual you see the hole day
exchanges.answer: I didn't see any holes. I was making desserts. No strange thing happened that I noticed.

exchanges.answer: Sure, I can look around. I'll check the kitchen and the back hall. I’ll keep an eye on the dessert station, too. Let me know if you see anything.

exchanges.answer: Hello. I am Dr. Alan Reed. I am 45 years old. I work as a doctor. I like books. I don't like loud noise. I am in the lounge, reading a book. I am here to check on guests.

exchanges.answer: I don’t drink wine. I prefer quiet time with a good book.
